zeitlin2013.citation: Zeitlin C. et al. Measurements of energetic particle radiation in transit to Mars on the Mars Science Laboratory. Science 340:1080-1084 (2013).
zeitlin2013.evidence: Measured. One instrument (MSL RAD) inside the cruise stage, 253 days.

hassler2014.citation: Hassler D.M. et al. Mars' surface radiation environment measured with the Mars Science Laboratory's Curiosity rover. Science 343:1244797 (2014).
hassler2014.evidence: Measured on the surface, one instrument (RAD). The full-mission value is a model estimate.

std3001.citation: NASA Space Flight Human-System Standard, Volume 1: Crew Health, Rev B (2022). Radiation Technical Brief.
std3001.evidence: Standard. The career limit uses a cancer-risk model only.

std3001appF.citation: NASA Space Flight Human-System Standard, Volume 2: Human Factors, Habitability, and Environmental Health, Appendix F (display and alert classes).

noaaScale.citation: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. Space Weather Scales: Solar Radiation Storms (S1 = 10 pfu of protons at 10 MeV or more).
noaaScale.evidence: Operational definition. Check against the DONKI SEP definition before the pitch.

donki.citation: NASA CCMC Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (DONKI): FLR, CME, and SEP records.
donki.evidence: Event catalog near Earth. It does not measure dose at the vehicle.

berger2024.citation: Berger T. et al. Artemis I radiation measurements. Nature (2024).
berger2024.evidence: Measured in phantoms on Orion. Validate: add the DOI before the pitch.

team.citation: CSI team value for the Space Apps 2026 demo. Not a NASA flight rule. See PRD CSI-HM-PRD-001 Rev C, section 07.
